tools.name: get_latest_posts
tools.description: Devuelve las últimas entradas publicadas y públicas del blog (solo lectura).

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Devuelve una entrada publicada y pública por su ID (solo lectura).

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Busca entradas publicadas y públicas por texto (solo lectura).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_latest_posts, get_post, search_posts · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_latest_posts, get_post, search_posts · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
